    if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) or model == player.Character then return end
    local data = BallTypes[ballType]
    if ballType == "Light" then
        playSound(data.SoundHit, model.HumanoidRootPart, 3)
        for _,v in pairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,150), Material=Enum.Material.Neon}):Play() local hl=Instance.new("Highlight", v) hl.FillColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,0) hl.FillTransparency=0.2 end end
        task.wait(0.6)
        for _,v in pairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(1), {Transparency=1}):Play() end end
        task.wait(1) model:Destroy()
    elseif ballType == "Ice" then
        playSound(data.SoundHit, model.HumanoidRootPart, 3)
        for _,v in pairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.Anchored=true v.Color=Color3.fromRGB(100,200,255) v.Material=Enum.Material.Ice end end

    elseif ballType == "Blackhole" then

local function makeFloat(ball)
    local att = Instance.new("Attachment", ball)
    local force = Instance.new("VectorForce", ball)
    force.Attachment0 = att
    force.Force = Vector3.new(0, ball:GetMass() * workspace.Gravity, 0)
    force.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    force.Parent = ball
    ball.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0,5,0)

    if floatConn then floatConn:Disconnect() end
    -- NO SLOW DOWN FLOAT, keep Y level
    floatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not ball or not ball.Parent or isReturning then return end
        -- keep same Y, no drop
        local vel = ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        -- only correct Y, keep X,Z speed same
        if math.abs(vel.Y) > 1 then
            ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, vel.Y * 0.99, vel.Z)
        else
            ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
        end
        -- enforce constant speed
        if ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < lastSpeed - 5 then
            ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity = ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Unit * lastSpeed
        end
    end)
end

local function throwBall()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    if thrownBall then thrownBall:Destroy() end
    if floatConn then floatConn:Disconnect() end
    if char:FindFirstChild("ThorBall") then char.ThorBall.Handle.Transparency = 1 end

    local typeData = BallTypes[getgenv().SelectedBallType]
    lastSpeed = typeData.Speed
    local ball = Instance.new("Part")
    ball.Name = "ThorBall_Thrown"
    ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    ball.Size = Vector3.new(3.2,3.2,3.2)
    ball.Color = typeData.Color
    ball.Material = typeData.Material
    ball.CanCollide = true
    ball.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.1, 1, 0, 1, 1) -- Elasticity 1 = NO SLOW DOWN
    ball.CFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,1.5,-4)
    ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * typeData.Speed
    ball.Parent = workspace
    thrownBall = ball

    makeFloat(ball)
    addBallVFX(ball, getgenv().SelectedBallType)
    playSound(typeData.SoundThrow, ball, 2)

    local trail = Instance.new("Trail", ball)
    trail.Attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment", ball)
    trail.Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment", ball)
    trail.Attachment1.Position = Vector3.new(0,0.5,0)
    trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(typeData.Trail)
    trail.Lifetime = 0.7

    local debounce=false
    ball.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        if isReturning or not hit then return end
        if hit:IsDescendantOf(char) then return end
        local model=hit.Parent
        -- DAMAGE CHECK FIRST
        if model:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
            if debounce then return end
            debounce=true
            local expl=Instance.new("Explosion",workspace) expl.BlastRadius=8 expl.BlastPressure=0 expl.Position=ball.Position expl.DestroyJointRadiusPercent=0
            applyEffect(ball.Position, model, getgenv().SelectedBallType)
            if floatConn then floatConn:Disconnect() end
            ball:Destroy() thrownBall=nil
            if char:FindFirstChild("ThorBall") then char.ThorBall.Handle.Transparency=0 end
            return
        end

        -- BOUNCE WITH NO SLOW DOWN
        if not debounce then
            local normal = (ball.Position - hit.Position).Unit
            local vel = ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local dot = vel:Dot(normal)
            local reflected = vel - (2 * dot * normal)
            -- KEEP SAME SPEED
            ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity = reflected.Unit * lastSpeed
            playSound("rbxassetid://12222030", ball, 1)
        end
    end)
    Debris:AddItem(ball, 30)
end

local function returnBall()
    if not thrownBall or isReturning then return end
    isReturning=true
    if floatConn then floatConn:Disconnect() end
    playSound("rbxassetid://12222124", thrownBall, 3)
    thrownBall.CanCollide=false
    thrownBall.Anchored=true
    local char=player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then isReturning=false return end
    local tween=TweenService:Create(thrownBall, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {CFrame=char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,1.5,-4)})
    tween:Play() tween.Completed:Wait()
    if thrownBall then thrownBall:Destroy() thrownBall=nil end
    if char:FindFirstChild("ThorBall") then char.ThorBall.Handle.Transparency=0 end
    isReturning=false
end

ballBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(createTool)
returnBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(returnBall)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local char=player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local t=char:FindFirstChild("ThorBall")
    if t and not t:FindFirstChild("ActivatedConn") then
        local c=Instance.new("BoolValue", t) c.Name="ActivatedConn"
        t.Activated:Connect(function() if not thrownBall then throwBall() end end)
    end
end)
createTool()
]])()

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
if not animator then
	animator = Instance.new("Animator")
	animator.Parent = humanoid
end

local animations = {
	["TV TIME"] = "rbxassetid://75202452138001",
}

local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
local currentTrack = nil
local currentTool = nil

local function toggleAnimation(animId, tool)
	if currentTrack and currentTool == tool then
		currentTrack:Stop()
		currentTrack:Destroy()
		currentTrack = nil
		currentTool = nil
	else
		if currentTrack then
			currentTrack:Stop()
			currentTrack:Destroy()
		end
		local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
		anim.AnimationId = animId
		currentTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
		currentTrack.Looped = true
		currentTrack:Play()
		currentTrack:AdjustSpeed(2)
		currentTool = tool
	end
end

for name, animId in pairs(animations) do
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = name
	tool.RequiresHandle = false
	tool.Parent = backpack

	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		toggleAnimation(animId, tool)
	end)
end

-- LocalScript

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- SETTINGS
local SPEED = 50
local ACCELERATION = 3
local SPIN_POWER = 1

-- HUMANOID
humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
humanoid.JumpPower = 0
humanoid.AutoRotate = false
humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)

for _, state in ipairs({
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp,
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping,
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing,
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall,
}) do
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(state, false)
end

local animate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
if animate then
	animate.Disabled = true
end

-- ZERO GRAVITY
local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
attachment.Name = "ZeroGravityAttachment"
attachment.Parent = root

local gravityForce = Instance.new("VectorForce")
gravityForce.Name = "ZeroGravity"
gravityForce.Attachment0 = attachment
gravityForce.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
gravityForce.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
gravityForce.Force = Vector3.new(
	0,
	root.AssemblyMass * workspace.Gravity,
	0
)
gravityForce.Parent = root

-- IDLE
local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

if animator then
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://180435571"

	local idle = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	idle.Looped = true
	idle.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
	idle:Play()
end

-- INPUT
local keys = {
	W = false,
	A = false,
	S = false,
	D = false,
	Space = false,
	Ctrl = false
}

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then keys.W = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then keys.A = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then keys.S = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then keys.D = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then keys.Space = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then keys.Ctrl = true end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then keys.W = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then keys.A = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then keys.S = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then keys.D = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then keys.Space = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then keys.Ctrl = false end
end)

-- MOVEMENT
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end

	local movement = Vector3.zero

	if keys.W then
		movement += camera.CFrame.LookVector

local function GetNearestPlayerInFront(targetPlayer, maxAngle)
    maxAngle = maxAngle or 60

    if not targetPlayer.Character then return nil end
    local targetHRP = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHRP then return nil end

    local targetLook = targetHRP.CFrame.LookVector

    local closest = nil
    local closestDist = math.huge

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p ~= targetPlayer and p.Character then

            if hrp then

    box.Text = tostring(default)

    corner.Parent = box

    stroke.Color = JOJO_PURPLE
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Parent = box

        stroke.Color = JOJO_GOLD
    end)

        stroke.Color = JOJO_PURPLE

        local num = tonumber(box.Text)

-- Dragging
-- The decorative Star Platinum and menacing images are children of mainFrame,
-- so they automatically move with the controller.
do
    local dragging = false
    local dragStart = Vector2.new()
    local startPos = mainFrame.Position

    mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            -- Don't drag when clicking controls or decorative images.
            if input.Target == closeBtn
                or input.Target == guiToggle
                or input.Target == targetBox
                or input.Target == standBtn
                or input.Target == punchBtn
                or input.Target == posBox
                or input.Target == offBox
                or input.Target == heightBox then
                return
            end

            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = mainFrame.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if dragging then
            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local delta = mousePos - dragStart

            local newX = math.clamp(
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                0,
                workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X - mainFrame.Size.X.Offset
            )

            local newY = math.clamp(
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y,
                0,
                workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y - mainFrame.Size.Y.Offset
            )

            mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, newX, 0, newY)
        end
    end)
end


local function findTargetByName(namePart)
    if not namePart or namePart == "" then
        return nil
    end

    namePart = namePart:lower()

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p.Name:lower():find(namePart) then
            return p
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function enableStand()
    for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = false
        end
    end

    if not bp then
        bp = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
        bp.MaxForce = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5)
        bp.P = 2000
        bp.D = 50
        bp.Position = humanoidRootPart.Position
        bp.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    end

    if not gyro then
        gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        gyro.P = 2000
        gyro.D = 50
        gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5)
        gyro.CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
        gyro.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    end
end

local function disableStand()
    for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = true
        end
    end

    if bp then
        bp:Destroy()
        bp = nil
    end

    if gyro then
        gyro:Destroy()
        gyro = nil
    end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if standOn and bp and gyro and targetBox.Text ~= "" then

        if vanished and savedCharacterCFrame then
            bp.Position = Vector3.new(
                savedCharacterCFrame.Position.X,
                VANISH_HEIGHT,
                savedCharacterCFrame.Position.Z
            )

            gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                bp.Position,
                bp.Position + savedCharacterCFrame.LookVector
            )

            return
        end

        floatTime += dt * 2
        local floatOffset = math.sin(floatTime) * 0.5

        local t = findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

        if t and t.Character and t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local targetHRP = t.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local tcf = targetHRP.CFrame
            local desiredPos

            if blocking then
                desiredPos =
                    tcf.Position
                    + tcf.LookVector * BLOCK_DISTANCE
                    + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0)
            else
                desiredPos =
                    tcf.Position
                    - tcf.LookVector * standDistance
                    + tcf.RightVector * sideOffset
                    + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset + floatOffset, 0)
            end

            bp.Position = bp.Position:Lerp(
                desiredPos,
                math.clamp(followSpeed, 0.01, 1)
            )

            gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                humanoidRootPart.Position,
                humanoidRootPart.Position + tcf.LookVector
            )
        end
    end
end)

local function runPastebinStyleFling(duration)
    local start = tick()
    local movel = 0.1

    while tick() - start < duration do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

        local c = player.Character
        local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if hrp then
            local vel = hrp.Velocity

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel * 10000
                + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)

            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()

            hrp.Velocity = vel

            RunService.Stepped:Wait()

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel
                + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)

            movel = -movel
        end
    end
end

local function punchTarget()
    local punchAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    punchAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://86464152593138"

    local punchTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(punchAnim)
    punchTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    punchTrack:Play()

    task.delay(1, function()
        if punchTrack then
            punchTrack:Stop()
            punchTrack:Destroy()
        end
    end)

    local targetPlayer = findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

    if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then
        return
    end

    local targetHRP =
        targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not targetHRP then
        return
    end

    SendChatMessage("ORA! ORA! ORA! ORA!")

    local nearest = GetNearestPlayerInFront(targetPlayer)

    if not nearest then
        return
    end

    local wasStandOn = standOn

    if wasStandOn then
        standOn = false
        standBtn.Text = "「 STAND: OFF 」"
        disableStand()
    end

    humanoidRootPart.CFrame =
        CFrame.new(nearest.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))

    local tempBP = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
    tempBP.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    tempBP.P = 4000
    tempBP.D = 100
    tempBP.Position = nearest.Position
    tempBP.Parent = humanoidRootPart

    local tempGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    tempGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    tempGyro.P = 4000
    tempGyro.D = 100
    tempGyro.CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
    tempGyro.Parent = humanoidRootPart

    local followConnection

    followConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not (
            tempBP
            and tempGyro
            and nearest
            and nearest.Parent
        ) then
            return
        end

        tempBP.Position = nearest.Position

        local lookVec = nearest.CFrame.LookVector

        tempGyro.CFrame =
            CFrame.new(
                humanoidRootPart.Position,
                humanoidRootPart.Position + lookVec
            )
    end)

    task.delay(followDuration, function()
        if followConnection then
            followConnection:Disconnect()
            followConnection = nil
        end

        if tempBP then
            tempBP:Destroy()
            tempBP = nil
        end

        if tempGyro then
            tempGyro:Destroy()
            tempGyro = nil
        end
    end)

    local effect = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
    effect.Saturation = -1
    effect.Parent = game.Lighting

    local s = Instance.new("Sound", humanoidRootPart)
    s.SoundId = punchSoundId
    s.Volume = 1
    s:Play()
    Debris:AddItem(s, 3)

    task.delay(0.2, function()
        local s2 = Instance.new("Sound", humanoidRootPart)
        s2.SoundId = heavyPunchSoundId
        s2.Volume = 1
        s2:Play()
        Debris:AddItem(s2, 3)
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        runPastebinStyleFling(flingDuration)
    end)

    task.delay(flingDuration + 0.25, function()
        if followConnection then
            followConnection:Disconnect()
            followConnection = nil
        end

        if tempBP then
            tempBP:Destroy()
            tempBP = nil
        end

        if tempGyro then
            tempGyro:Destroy()
            tempGyro = nil
        end

        if effect and effect.Parent then
            effect:Destroy()
        end

        if wasStandOn then
            standOn = true
            standBtn.Text = "「 STAND: ON 」"
            enableStand()

            if bp then
                bp.Position = humanoidRootPart.Position
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function onPlayerChatted(otherPlayer, message)
    local targetName = targetBox.Text

    if not targetName or targetName == "" then
        return
    end

    local lowerMessage = message:lower()

    local targetMatches =
        otherPlayer.Name:lower():find(targetName:lower())

    if not targetMatches then
        return
    end

    if standOn and lowerMessage:find("barrage") then
        punchTarget()
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("block")
        and standOn
        and not vanished
        and not blocking then

        blocking = true
        SendChatMessage("BLOCK")
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("unblock")
        and standOn
        and blocking then

        blocking = false
        SendChatMessage("UNBLOCK")
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("vanish")
        and standOn
        and not vanished then

        vanished = true

        savedCharacterCFrame =
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        savedCameraSubject = camera.CameraSubject

        humanoidRootPart.CFrame =
            CFrame.new(
                humanoidRootPart.Position.X,
                VANISH_HEIGHT,
                humanoidRootPart.Position.Z
            )

        local target =
            findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

        if target and target.Character then
            local targetHumanoid =
                target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if targetHumanoid then
                camera.CameraSubject = targetHumanoid
            end
        end

        SendChatMessage("Yare Yare Daze")
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("summon") then

        if blocking then
            blocking = false
        end

        if vanished then
            vanished = false

            if savedCharacterCFrame
                and humanoidRootPart
                and humanoidRootPart.Parent then

                humanoidRootPart.CFrame =
                    savedCharacterCFrame
            end

            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

            if humanoid then
                camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
            elseif savedCameraSubject then
                camera.CameraSubject = savedCameraSubject
            end

            savedCharacterCFrame = nil
            savedCameraSubject = nil

            SendChatMessage("Star Platinum, Toki wo Tomare")
            return
        end

        standOn = not standOn

        standBtn.Text =
            standOn
            and "「 STAND: ON 」"
            or "「 STAND: OFF 」"

        if standOn then
            enableStand()

local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
local jb = 14

local function setup(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local joint = root:WaitForChild("RootJoint")
	local c0 = joint.C0
	local on = false

	local function stop()
		if on then
			rs:UnbindFromRenderStep("backflip")
			on = false
		end
		if joint.Parent then
			joint.C0 = c0
		end
	end

	hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
		if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
			if on then
				stop()
			end
			return
		end
		if new ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then return end
		stop()
		on = true
		local md0 = hum.MoveDirection
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
		local look = Vector3.new(cam.LookVector.X, 0, cam.LookVector.Z).Unit
		local right = Vector3.new(cam.RightVector.X, 0, cam.RightVector.Z).Unit
		local dir
		if md0.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			dir = -Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
		else
			local f = md0:Dot(look)
			local r = md0:Dot(right)
			if math.abs(f) >= math.abs(r) then
				dir = f > 0 and look or -look
			else
				dir = r > 0 and right or -right
			end
		end
		local axis = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis:Cross(dir)).Unit
		local g = workspace.Gravity
		local v = (hum.UseJumpPower and hum.JumpPower or math.sqrt(2 * g * hum.JumpHeight)) + jb
		local dur = math.max(2 * v / g * 0.95, 0.35)
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local boosted = false
		rs:BindToRenderStep("backflip", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
			local a = (os.clock() - t0) / dur
			if a >= 1 or hum.Health <= 0 or not root.Parent then
				stop()
				return
			end
			if not boosted then
				boosted = true
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += Vector3.new(0, jb, 0)
			end
			joint.C0 = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, a * math.pi * 2) * c0
		end)
	end)
end

if plr.Character then
	task.spawn(setup, plr.Character)
end

        local flatTargetCFrame = currentRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
        currentRootPart.CFrame = flatTargetCFrame
        
        -- Apply locking forces
        rotationGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        rotationGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5) 
        rotationGyro.D = 100 
        rotationGyro.P = 10000 
        rotationGyro.CFrame = flatTargetCFrame 
        rotationGyro.Parent = currentRootPart
        
        movementVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        movementVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6) 
        movementVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) 
        movementVelocity.Parent = currentRootPart
    else
        FlightButton.Text = "FLY (ENABLE)"
        FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 180)
        ControlFrame.Visible = false
        
        currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        currentRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentRootPart.Position)
    end
end

-- Hook up Character Re-binding loops (Fires every time you respawn)
local function onCharacterAdded(newCharacter)
    currentCharacter = newCharacter
    currentHumanoid = newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    currentRootPart = newCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    -- Instantly enforce the flight/flat physics if it was left ON when you died
    updatePhysicsState()
end

-- Connect to existing character, and listen for future spawns
if LocalPlayer.Character then onCharacterAdded(LocalPlayer.Character) end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

-- Minimize/Maximize UI Logic
MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isMinimized = not isMinimized
    if isMinimized then
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 40)
        ControlFrame.Visible = false
        MinBtn.Text = "+"
    else
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 200)
        if flightActive then ControlFrame.Visible = true end
        MinBtn.Text = "-"
    end
end)

-- Manual UI Toggle Button Press Listener
FlightButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    flightActive = not flightActive
    updatePhysicsState()
end)

-- Velocity Controller Direction mapping
local function applyPhysicsVelocity(directionVector)
    if not flightActive or not movementVelocity then return end
    movementVelocity.Velocity = directionVector * MOVEMENT_SPEED
end

-- Button click/tap bindings
UpBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) end)
UpBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

DownBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)) end)
DownBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

LeftBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)) end)
LeftBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

RightBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)) end)
RightBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)
